description: This file defines the BrowseFragment class, which manages the browsing UI in an Android TV app using Leanback components. It sets up the UI, loads media items into rows, and handles navigation to detail screens. It also includes a MediaCardPresenter for rendering media item cards.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a browsing UI with rows of media items, manages UI setup, data loading, and navigation.

classes.name: MediaCardPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter implementation that creates and binds media item cards for display in the browsing UI.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and loads media rows after fragment activity is created.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the support fragment's UI properties, such as title, colors, headers, and adapter.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Populates the UI with media items in a list row, using placeholder data.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder for media item card view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds media item data to the card view, including title, rating, and image.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image from the card view when unbinding.
